sql: SELECT ps.set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, ps.est_operations, ps.site_source, st.fei, st.firm_name, st.country_iso3, st.address FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE ps.set_id IN ('c5f65e5b-c851-45da-a0e8-215d9a4e6ad3', '1cd3d47b-025f-4705-9daf-cf07725ec223') ORDER BY ps.set_id, ps.establishment
